segments.text: Some customer emails are a breeze. Short, clear, easy to process. But others, not so much. Long descriptions, mismatching names, vague references.
Suddenly, you're spending time deciphering, searching, even chasing the customer for clarification. That's exactly the kind of challenge the sales order agent was built to handle.

Inside Business Central, the sales order agent carefully processes the email and presents a suggested result directly in the agent pane. The agent had no issues identifying both direct matches and other items with matching characteristics, checked their availability,
and prepared a ready to send reply, saving lots of time, usually spent reading and rereading the email, looking up the items one by one. Curious how it could be so thorough?

It wasn't just a simple search by description. The agent uses multiple search parameters across many sources to deliver the best results such as the description, additional description, GTN number, and the item category code and description.

But it doesn't stop there. Also, searching through supplemental data linked to the items. In its search, it considers item attributes like material, size, color, weight, or dimensions, which are especially helpful when customers get specific in their requests.
It also searches among item variants, different versions of the same item in Business Central, for example, stationary or mobile models, or variations in size, color, or style.
The search includes item identifiers, alternative codes used for items in Business Central, such as vendor numbers, barcodes, or customer specific codes that uniquely identify the item.

It also goes through item references. Additional links in Business Central such as customer item numbers or vendor item numbers that help match the way different parties refer to the same item in their own systems.
Search includes the information captured in the extended text and translations, ensuring that these detailed descriptions or requests in different languages are analyzed to find the right item match.

With its advanced search capabilities powered by natural language understanding, the agent can easily recognize and find the requested items where customers use their own codes or other ways of naming items.

It can interpret those details, match them against your data, and ensure nothing gets lost in translation. Clear or complicated, customer requests get processed more efficiently, saving your time and reducing back and forth, adding more joy to your interactions with your customers and with your business central.
